visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a colorful geometric patterned jacket over a bright red hoodie and a dark blue baseball cap approaches a dark wooden door in a brightly lit hallway. He leans in to press a silver doorbell button next to a plaque that reads "RECM studio" and "13F". He wears white-rimmed sunglasses perched on his cap. (2) A fisheye-lens perspective from the doorbell camera shows the man holding a large red paper bag with "KFC" branding. He smiles widely, looking directly into the lens, and performs a playful hand gesture near his chest while wearing dark sunglasses. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of a minimalist studio. The man enters from the left, now holding a large, rough-edged cardboard piece with handwritten Chinese characters in black ink. He raises the sign above his head, standing in a brightly lit corridor with a large window in the background. (4) Transitions show the man in various outdoor locations at night. He is seen on a street corner with glowing neon business signs, then at a busy intersection in Ximending with crowds of people walking behind him, and finally sitting cross-legged on a tiled sidewalk in front of a closed white metal storefront shutter, holding his cardboard sign steadily.
